title: Echo in the Abandoned Theater
description: A woman in a flowing emerald green dress stands in a dilapidated room filled with scattered film reels, VHS tapes, and broken frames. She holds a framed painting of herself while sound waves emanate from her mouth toward an old film projector casting light across a desert landscape visible through the open wall under an aurora borealis sky.
prompt: A woman in a flowing emerald green Victorian dress stands inside a decaying room with peeling blue walls covered in old framed paintings. She holds a large portrait of herself while emitting glowing sound waves from her open mouth. An antique film projector on a pedestal beams light across the scene, surrounded by scattered VHS tapes, film reels, and broken cassette tapes on the wooden floor. Through the open side of the room is a vast desert under a purple night sky with green aurora borealis. Cinematic surreal composition, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
